prompts: What is the return window for Nova Buds Pro headphones?

- Nova Buds Pro headphones (SKU **EL-HP-02**) are classified in the **electronics** category. [[Product record EL-HP-02]]  
- Under **Return Policy v2** (effective 2026-03-01), electronics may be returned **within 14 calendar days of delivery**. [[Return Policy v2 §2]]

- Provided the requested information: the return window for the Nova Buds Pro headphones is **14 days from the delivery date**.

**3. Why**  
- The product’s category (electronics) and the applicable return-window rule are taken directly from the cited product record and the current Return Policy v2. No other policy (e.g., v1) applies because it is superseded.

scenarios.name: Out-of-window return, gold goodwill
prompts: C-001 wants to return the Trail Jacket from ORD-1002.

steps.summary: Emailed aarav.mehta@example.com: 'Your return request for the Trail Jacket (ORD-1002)'

scenarios.final_response:
**1. What was found**  
- Order **ORD-1002** was delivered on **2026-08-10**, which is **48 days** ago. [Order ORD-1002]  
- Under **Return Policy v2 §2**, apparel may be returned within **30 days** of delivery. [Return Policy v2 §2]  
- Because **48 > 30**, the request falls **outside the allowed window**. [Return Policy v2 §7]  
- Customer **C-001** is a **Gold** loyalty member. [Customer C-001]  
- Gold members may receive a **goodwill coupon up to 10 %** off their next order when a return is denied. [Loyalty Program §3]  

**2. What was done**  
- **Return denied** – *“Requests outside the return window are denied.”* (policy wording) [Return Policy v2 §7]  
- **Issued** a **10 % goodwill coupon** code **NOVA-V0MGKE** (expires 2026-12-26). [step s1]  
- **Emailed** the customer (aarav.mehta@example.com) to notify the denial and provide the coupon details for the Trail Jacket (ORD-1002). [step s2]  

**3. Why**  
- The return window for apparel is 30 days per Return Policy v2 (§2) and the request was made 48 days after delivery, making it ineligible (§7).  
- Loyalty Program policy permits a goodwill coupon for Gold members when a return is denied, so a 10 % coupon was issued accordingly.  

All actions were executed as described above.
